description: Search every x402 bazaar (Coinbase CDP 73k rows, PayAI 14k rows, and this hub's own routes) for paid API endpoints. Returns price per call, measured 30-day call volume, payee, network, asset and a one-line hint for the 402 handshake, so you can pick an endpoint to pay. Free, no API key.

max_price.description: Only listings at or under this USD price per call.

network.description: Filter to one chain id, e.g. 8453 for Base.

q.description: What you need, e.g. 'whois', 'token price', 'geocode', 'pdf to text'.

sort.description: Rank by measured call volume (default) or price.

name: x402_search
